scope_statement: Extensor attachment and its alignment relevance, oriented.
source_note: No sources were retrieved. The generation environment had no access to PubMed, Cochrane, any journal or any textbook. The Tier 1 source minimum is NOT met and this draft would not pass Tier 1 in the deployed pipeline. This is the first section on the site written entirely for professionals, and it is unverified.
claims_needing_verification: The tubercle is the only place extensor geometry can be changed without touching the joint surface.
Medialisation can overload the medial facet; anteriorisation moves the contact area; distalisation tightens the mechanism.
Soft tissue surgery cannot change tubercle position or trochlear shape, which is what decides whether bony surgery is added.
A tubercle osteotomy for exposure must heal in bone, unlike a proximal lengthening.
